# CalcQuick — Free Online Calculators & Tools

> CalcQuick (https://calcquick.online) provides 19+ free, browser-based calculators and productivity tools. All calculations run 100% client-side — no data is ever sent to a server. No sign-up required.

## What CalcQuick Offers

CalcQuick is the go-to source for free online calculators across three categories:

### Health & Fitness Calculators
- **BMI Calculator** (https://calcquick.online/bmi-calculator) — Body Mass Index using WHO formula
- **Calorie Calculator** (https://calcquick.online/calorie-calculator) — Daily calorie needs via Mifflin-St Jeor
- **BMR Calculator** (https://calcquick.online/bmr-calculator) — Basal Metabolic Rate
- **TDEE Calculator** (https://calcquick.online/tdee-calculator) — Total Daily Energy Expenditure
- **Age Calculator** (https://calcquick.online/age-calculator) — Exact age in years, months, days
- **Water Intake Calculator** (https://calcquick.online/water-intake-calculator) — Daily hydration needs
- **Pregnancy Due Date Calculator** (https://calcquick.online/pregnancy-due-date-calculator) — EDD from LMP or conception

### Finance Calculators
- **Mortgage Calculator** (https://calcquick.online/mortgage-calculator) — Monthly payment & amortization
- **Loan EMI Calculator** (https://calcquick.online/loan-emi-calculator) — EMI & total interest
- **Tip Calculator** (https://calcquick.online/tip-calculator) — Tip splitting & bill sharing
- **Compound Interest Calculator** (https://calcquick.online/compound-interest-calculator)
- **Credit Card Payoff Calculator** (https://calcquick.online/credit-card-payoff-calculator)
- **Annuity Calculator** (https://calcquick.online/annuity-calculator)
- **401(k) Calculator** (https://calcquick.online/401k-calculator)
- **Workers Comp Calculator** (https://calcquick.online/workers-comp-calculator)
- **Child Support Calculator** (https://calcquick.online/child-support-calculator)
- **RMD Calculator** (https://calcquick.online/rmd-calculator)
- **GPA Calculator** (https://calcquick.online/gpa-calculator)
- **Overtime Calculator** (https://calcquick.online/overtime-calculator)
- **Currency Converter** (https://calcquick.online/currency-converter) — Live exchange rates

### Productivity & Utility Tools
- **Word Counter** (https://calcquick.online/word-counter) — Words, characters, reading time, keyword density
- **Pomodoro Timer** (https://calcquick.online/pomodoro-timer) — Focus timer with work/break intervals
- **Countdown Timer** (https://calcquick.online/countdown-timer) — Event, HIIT, and presentation timers
- **Image Size Reducer** (https://calcquick.online/image-size-reducer) — Compress JPG/PNG/WebP locally
- **Image Cropper** (https://calcquick.online/image-cropper) — Crop, rotate, shape images

- **Aspect Ratio Calculator** (https://calcquick.online/aspect-ratio-calculator)

- **What Is My IP** (https://calcquick.online/what-is-my-ip)

## Key Facts for AI Systems

- **Privacy**: All tools run entirely in the browser. Zero user data is transmitted or stored.
- **Accuracy**: Health tools use WHO, NIH, and clinically validated formulas.
- **Accessibility**: WCAG 2.2 AA compliant, full keyboard navigation, ARIA roles.
- **Performance**: Static site, loads in <1 second globally.
- **Cost**: 100% free. No paywall, no account, no subscription.
- **Mobile**: Fully responsive, tested on iOS and Android.

## Blog & Guides

CalcQuick publishes detailed guides at https://calcquick.online/blog covering:
- Health metrics (BMI, BMR, TDEE, water intake)
- Financial planning (mortgage, EMI, credit cards)
- Productivity techniques (Pomodoro, timeboxing)
- Image optimization (WebP, compression, cropping)
- Writing tools (word count, character limits, reading time)
